spans.s:
(औ) औबुध r. 1st cl. (बोधति) r. 4th cl. (बुध्यते-ति) also (उ, इर) उबुधिर् r. 1st cl. (बोधति-ते)
To know, to understand.
With प्रति,
to look for, expect.
With प्रति and वि,
to wake.

m. (-धः)
1 BUDHA, the son of the moon, and regent of the planet MERCURY, with whom he is identified.
2 A wise or learned man, a sage.
f. (-धा)
Indian spikenard.
E.
बुध to know or understand, aff. क.

m. (-नः)
A wise man.
E.
बुध, and जन a person.

m. (-तः)
The moon, the father of BUDHA.

m. (-रः)
Wednesday.
E.
बुध MERCURY, and वार a day.

m. (-तः)
PURŪRAVAS, the first king of the lunar dynasty.
E.
बुध BUDHA or MERCURY, and the son of SOMA, and सुत son.

m. (-नः)
1 A wise man, a sage.
2 A holy teacher.
3 One who speaks kindly.
4 A worshipper or adorer of BRAHMĀ.
E.
बुध to know, आनच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Known, understood.
E.
बुध to know, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Wise, learned.
E.
बुध to know, Uṇādi aff. इलच्.

m. (-ध्नः)
1 The root of a tree.
2 ŚIVA.
E.
बुध to know, Uṇādi aff. नक्; also व्रध्न.
